description: Source code for the Ethernet driver for LAN865x chip in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, configuration, reset, and data handling functions.

methods.name: lan865x_mac_rxtx_control
methods.description: Controls the MAC transmit/receive enable state.

methods.name: lan865x_iface_init
methods.description: Initializes network interface with MAC address and link.

methods.name: lan865x_port_get_capabilities
methods.description: Returns hardware capabilities of the Ethernet port.

methods.name: lan865x_set_config
methods.description: Sets various Ethernet configurations such as promiscuous mode, MAC address, and T1S parameters.

methods.name: lan865x_write_macaddress
methods.description: Writes the MAC address to the hardware registers.

methods.name: lan865x_default_config
methods.description: Applies default configuration to the LAN865x chip.

methods.name: lan865x_int_callback
methods.description: Interrupt callback for handling hardware interrupts.

methods.name: lan865x_read_chunks
methods.description: Reads data chunks from the hardware and processes received packets.

methods.name: lan865x_int_thread
methods.description: Thread function for handling hardware interrupts and events.

methods.name: lan865x_init
methods.description: Initializes the LAN865x device, including SPI and GPIO configuration.

methods.name: lan865x_port_send
methods.description: Sends a network packet through the LAN865x hardware.
